test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code, 'best way to win’ is written as 'fa ka la ju’, 'the way to hell’ is written as ‘Iu la hu fa’, ‘win of the day’ is written as 'na lu fu ka’ and 'to sell of night’ is written as 'na li ya la’. Which of the following represents 'of the way’?
solution:
The code of each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c907715ab695a0933812a793f500423a098f10c8baa7ad31408d1563c33a96e5.png] 

The code for **of** is **na.**

code for **the** is** lu**.

Code for** way** is **fa.**

Clearly, **"of the way"** is represented by** "na lu fa".**

Hence, ‘**lu na fa**’ is the correct answer.
